purpose: Follow named workplace AI systems from governance or deployment through worker-control and household-outcome endpoints without pooling incompatible cases.

records.system_and_owner: IBM Germany AI systems; joint company and group works council
records.dated_implementation_or_rule: 2020-07-30 framework agreement; live implementation date not observed
records.worker_exposure: Named recommendation, training, career, call-center, and monitoring systems reported; worker-level exposure not observed
records.worker_voice: Group works-council agreement, AI experts, and ethics-council participation reported
records.specific_control_or_rule_change: Transparency, human final decision, correction, inspection, escalation, and high-risk personnel limits reported as rules
records.enforcement_or_appeal: Correction route is a reported rule; live intervention, compliance, and resolution are not observed
records.worker_outcome: Not observed: pay, time, discretion, stress, health, security, or bargaining outcome
records.household_outcome: Not observed: resources, care, debt, housing, food, or recovery
records.exit_or_collective_action: Collective governance architecture observed; worker refusal, transfer, quit, organizing, or employer response not observed
records.boundary: Anticipatory governance is not proof of live worker control or welfare improvement.

records.system_and_owner: Microsoft Places; Microsoft Digital product group with works-council approval conditions
records.dated_implementation_or_rule: 2025-05-08 reported product intervention during internal rollout
records.worker_exposure: Location sharing and cross-country visibility were the decision surface; worker take-up and actual exposure not observed
records.worker_voice: Works-council concern about cross-country location visibility reported
records.specific_control_or_rule_change: Country-level feature targeting and default opt-out for employee location sharing reported
records.enforcement_or_appeal: Approval-linked rollout reported; logs, challenge route, enforcement, and durability not observed
records.worker_outcome: Not observed: privacy, schedule control, workload, pay, health, security, or retaliation outcome
records.household_outcome: Not observed: care, time, resources, or household-security outcome
records.exit_or_collective_action: Opt-out design reported; actual opt-out, refusal consequence, switching, or collective action not observed
records.boundary: A company-reported product change is not independent proof of enforceable worker choice or improved welfare.

records.system_and_owner: Microsoft 365 Copilot; Microsoft Digital with European works-council review
records.dated_implementation_or_rule: 2024-2025 tolerance phase and spring 2025 reported approval; exact workplace implementation dates not observed
records.worker_exposure: Controlled employee testing, training, permissions, DLP, and dashboards reported; worker-level intensity not observed
records.worker_voice: Councils raised performance-ranking and sensitive-inference concerns; feedback reportedly reached product engineering
records.specific_control_or_rule_change: Guardrails, approval process, and staged rollout reported; specific feature/code change not disclosed
records.enforcement_or_appeal: Review process reported; review logs, prohibited-use enforcement, appeals, and anti-retaliation not observed
records.worker_outcome: Not observed: productivity, workload, time, pay, discretion, health, security, or job outcome
records.household_outcome: Not observed: care, resources, debt, or recovery outcome
records.exit_or_collective_action: Participation in testing reported; opt-out, refusal consequence, transfer, quit, or later collective action not observed
records.boundary: Company implementation reporting establishes a feedback loop, not a worker-level causal or representative result.

result: The named cases reach governance and, for Microsoft Places, a reported product-design change. None currently reaches independently observed enforcement, worker welfare, household security, or practical exit.
next_test: Obtain one worker-side, works-council, technical-release, or administrative artifact that links a named concern to a dated rule change and then measures actual exposure, override/appeal, workload/pace, pay, health, bargaining, household security, and exit against a differently governed workplace.
storage_boundary: Uses three committed local records; no raw-data acquisition or new estimate.
